Google external subscription versus Cloud invitation is made explicit without claiming globally absent webcal support.
Generic downloaded-file import distinction is not extended into a claim that app-tracked Cloud invitations never refresh.
Existing receiver-controlled refresh and non-recall boundaries remain; no automatic/immediate delivery claim added.
No material audit-speak: wording tells readers what to inspect and does not expose code-search or certification machinery.
